subject: inset function not working, and how to plot CI around the ancestral state

messages.author: 6ea68e7302e2b0a5
messages.subject: inset function not working, and how to plot CI around the ancestral state
parts:
Hey all

I have two questions-
1.  I am trying to reproduce https://guangchuangyu.github.io/software/ggtree/vignettes/ggtree-inset.html. Whereby the plot from the link works, but when I try it on my data, it does not.

Code used-
tree<-read.tree("500bps_termitetree.nwk")
nitrogen_meta_anc_state<-read.csv("nitrogen_metabolism_anc_state.csv")

p<-ggtree(tree)

nd <- data.frame(node = nitrogen_meta_anc_state$node, trait = nitrogen_meta_anc_state[,1:2]) #testing for the first two traits.
nd$node <- as.numeric(nd$node)
bars <- nodebar(nd, cols=2:3)

inset(p, bars, width=.2, height=1)

I get only the tree object. Inset is not plotted.

2. I have the CI values for the ancestral states also, but I cannot find any tutorial or vignette to be able to plot the ancestral state and their CI using ggtree. Is it possible? If yes, then could someone guide me to the correct resources?
